definition: Chlorofluorocarbons are compounds containing carbon, chlorine, and fluorine that can deplete stratospheric ozone after breaking down and releasing chlorine.
entry_text: Chlorofluorocarbons are compounds containing carbon, chlorine, and fluorine that can deplete stratospheric ozone after breaking down and releasing chlorine.
example: A technician identifies a legacy refrigerant as a CFC when documenting equipment for proper disposal.
label: Chlorofluorocarbons
